text:
Leah (CS): Heads-up: Harborline private rollout planned Thu 2025-08-14 02:00-03:00 UTC. Need ops + oncall signoff. Customer notified and asked for pinned version. See plan below.

Alex G: Confirming we will pin model to `rwd-gpt-short-v2@2025-08-12` and keep canary slice 10% for 30m -> 50% 30m -> 100%. Will also enable graceful fallback to hosted API for burst.

Samir K: Oncall, any scheduling conflicts? Also, SLA question — do we want automated fallback to hosted if Dedicated errors spike?

Oncall-SRE: No conflicts on my side. I'll be on pager for the window. Rollback thresholds proposed: error rate > 3% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > 750ms for 5m -> immediate rollback to previous pinned release. Also fallback to hosted API as secondary mitigation.

DeployBot: Deploy scheduled: 2025-08-14T02:00Z. Steps: pin-version -> create canary slice -> monitor kpis -> promote. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/harborline-rollout (internal). To abort during automated rollout reply `hold`.

Maria T: Posting release notes to customer and internal channels now. Link (internal): https://confluence.internal/redwood/harborline-release-notes. Will call out the maintenance window and expected perf impact.

Alex G: Canary config snippet: ```yaml
rollout_policy:
  - slice:
      canary_percent: 10
      duration: 30m
  - slice:
      canary_percent: 50
      duration: 30m
  - slice:
      canary_percent: 100
      duration: 15m
auto_rollback: true
rollback_metrics: [error_rate, p95_latency]
```

Samir K: I'll enable KV cache priming before the window: `cache.prime --tenant=harborline --prefix=common-requests` so first wave has warmed KV.

Leah (CS): Customer also asked to pin their embeddings model to `rwd-embed-v1.1` temporarily. CS OKs possible slight latency regression during first 24h.

Alex G: Acknowledged — will pin embeddings to `rwd-embed-v1.1` after canary step 1. Note: embeddings are behind a quota limiter, watch for throttling alarms.

Oncall-SRE: Approving from ops side. I will monitor dashboards and have rollback steps ready. :white_check_mark:

DevRel-Bot: Friendly reminder: change notification to infra-devs scheduled for 2025-08-14 01:30Z. Post-deploy checklist will be auto-run at +45m.

Alex G: All approvals received. @DeployBot kick off at 02:00Z as scheduled. If any manual hold required, reply `hold` in this thread. Post-deploy: smoke tests, latency + error regression, and customer confirmation.

DeployBot: Acknowledged. Rolling out in 5m (simulated). If you need to `hold`, reply now.
